frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root ء-م-ن contributes a single relational state: TRUST-SECURITY — being free from fear/danger because something or someone is relied upon as dependable. This one residue surfaces as: (a) the fear-free condition itself (amn, aaminiin, amanah = security-drowsiness, ma'man = place of safety); (b) the quality of being relied-upon (amiin = trustworthy, al-amaanah = a thing placed in trust); (c) the act of taking-as-trust (Form VIII i'tamana, 2:283 iu'tumina amaanatahu); (d) the intransitive being-secure/trusting (Form I amina: 7:97-99 afa-amina... = do they feel secure from God's stratagem; 12:11 laa ta'mannaa = you do not trust us); and (e) Form IV as the factitive/causative of that state, which is where the two surface senses branch by CONSTRUCTION, not by root: aamana + direct object + min = CONFER security (106:4 wa-aamanahum min khawf = He gave them security from fear; 59:23 al-Mu'min = the Granter-of-security among God's names), while aamana + bi = GRANT one's trust/reliance to, i.e. believe (put one's security in X by affirming it dependable). Faith (iimaan) is thus trust-reliance, and belief and safety are two applications of one trust-security core.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root ء-م-ن contributes a single relational state: TRUST-SECURITY — being free from fear/danger because something or someone is relied upon as dependable. This one residue surfaces as: (a) the fear-free condition itself (amn, aaminiin, amanah = security-drowsiness, ma'man = place of safety); (b) the quality of being relied-upon (amiin = trustworthy, al-amaanah = a thing placed in trust); (c) the act of taking-as-trust (Form VIII i'tamana, 2:283 iu'tumina amaanatahu); (d) the intransitive being-secure/trusting (Form I amina: 7:97-99 afa-amina... = do they feel secure from God's stratagem; 12:11 laa ta'mannaa = you do not trust us); and (e) Form IV as the factitive/causative of that state, which is where the two surface senses branch by CONSTRUCTION, not by root: aamana + direct object + min = CONFER security (106:4 wa-aamanahum min khawf = He gave them security from fear; 59:23 al-Mu'min = the Granter-of-security among God's names), while aamana + bi = GRANT one's trust/reliance to, i.e. believe (put one's security in X by affirming it dependable). Faith (iimaan) is thus trust-reliance, and belief and safety are two applications of one trust-security core.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every form of this root is about security-through-trust: feeling safe, being trustworthy, entrusting, or placing your trust/faith in something. Form I "amina" = to feel safe / to trust. Nouns give security (amn), a trust/deposit (amaanah), a trustworthy person (amiin), a safe place (ma'man). Form VIII "i'tamana" = to entrust. Form IV "aamana" is the causative: with min it means "make safe / grant security" (106:4 "gave them security from fear"; God's name al-Mu'min the Security-Giver), and with bi it means "believe in" — which is grammatically the same act of extending trust/reliance to something you hold dependable. So the 537 belief-verbs and 260 believer/faith-nouns are not a separate meaning; they are trust-reliance, the same core that produces amn (safety) and amaanah (trust).
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: ROOT residue = trust-security (fear-free reliance). FORM does the transforming: Form I = be in the trust-security state (stative/intransitive); Form IV = cause/confer that state (factitive); Form VIII = take-for-oneself as a trust (reflexive). CONSTRUCTION disambiguates Form IV's two surface readings without touching the root: aamana+bi routes trust toward an object of reliance (=believe), aamana+DO+min routes security toward a beneficiary against a threat (=make safe). CONTEXT supplies participants (God, messengers, the Book as objects of faith; hunger/fear/God's stratagem as threats). The belief/safety split that looks like polysemy is entirely a form+construction effect layered over one invariant root contribution — exactly the separation the method requires. Nearest confusable ROOT senses are removed: Form I "amina X" (fear-free-from) vs Form IV "aamana bi X" (trust-toward) are the same residue under different valence.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The belief-cluster (V(IV) aamanuu / N(IV) al-mu'miniin, ~797 tokens) superficially reads as "faith," a sense with no obvious "security" content, and could look like a second, unrelated meaning of the root. This is the one place universal presence could break. It is reconciled by three internal bridges within the packet itself: (1) 106:4 wa-aamanahum min khawf places the SAME Form IV verb in an unambiguous "grant security from fear" reading; (2) 59:23 al-Mu'min lists Form IV participle as a divine name of security-giving beside al-Salaam; (3) 12:17 wa-maa anta bi-mu'min lanaa uses the believer-participle to mean "you will not credit/trust us" — bare trust, no doctrinal "faith." These show the belief tokens are trust-reliance (aamana bi = entrust one's security to), i.e. the identical residue, so the counterexample does not survive.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Alternative: the root's core is narrowly "belief/faith" (assent to truth), with "security/safety" as a secondary or homonymous branch. This is rejected because (i) Form I and the security-nouns (amn, amaanah, amiin, ma'man, i'tamana) carry NO assent-to-truth content yet are the morphologically simpler, more basic layer — a truth-assent core could not generate them; (ii) 2:283 stacks amina / iu'tumina / amaanah in one verse about a commercial trust with zero doctrinal sense; (iii) the causative bridge 106:4 derives "faith" reading from the "security" reading, not the reverse. A rival gloss "affirm-as-true" (root ص-د-ق) fails because saddaqa lacks the reliance/fear-free dimension present here (aamana adds entrusting one's security, not merely conceding a fact).
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinctive and falsifiable against nearest roots: vs ط-م-ن (tuma'niina, inner calm) — 16:112 aaminatan mutma'innatan and 3:154 amanah+nu'aas keep amn as security-from-threat, distinct from settledness-of-heart, and the two roots co-occur precisely because they differ; vs س-ل-م (salaam, wholeness/peace) — 59:23 lists al-Salaam and al-Mu'min as separate divine names; vs ص-د-ق (affirm-true) — amn adds fear-free reliance beyond mere truth-assent; vs و-ث-ق (bind firmly/covenant) — wathaqa is binding-firmness, amn is the fear-free state that binding might secure. Residue is non-empty (trust-security), distinctive (fear-freedom + reliability, not calm, wholeness, truth, or binding), and falsifiable (any occurrence meaning safety/trust/faith yet lacking the fear-free-reliance nexus would break it — none found).
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage of all 879 confirmed occurrences by seven form clusters, each reconciled to one residue — trust-security — with the potentially-resistant belief cluster (~797 tokens) reconciled by three in-packet bridges (106:4 factitive "grant security from fear," 59:23 divine name al-Mu'min = security-giver, 12:17 mu'min = one who credits/trusts). The security pole (Form I amina, amn/amaanah/amiin/ma'man, Form VIII i'tamana) and the faith pole (Form IV aamana bi, iimaan, mu'min) are shown to be one root contribution differentiated only by form valence and bi- vs min- construction, satisfying strict root/form/construction separation. Residue is non-empty, distinctive against ط-م-ن / س-ل-م / ص-د-ق / و-ث-ق, and falsifiable. Zero occurrences resist. Strength STRONG rather than absolute only because the belief/security branching rides on a form+construction argument (defensible and internally evidenced) rather than a single uniform surface sense; but universal presence of the trust-security residue holds across every cited occurrence.

adversarial_verification.notes:
Adversarial refutation attempt failed: after exhaustively checking every confirmed occurrence and allowing form/construction/context subtraction, I could not name a single verse_ref where the TRUST-SECURITY residue (fear-free reliance on something dependable) is demonstrably absent.

Non-IV forms (all 67 examined individually) sit squarely in the field: N = amn/amanah/ma'man/ma'mun security nouns (2:125, 6:82, 9:6 ma'man, 70:28 ghayru ma'mun = not-to-be-felt-secure-from), amanah as thing-placed-in-trust (33:72, 4:58, 8:27, 23:8, 70:32), amanatan nu'asan = security-drowsiness (3:154, 8:11) -> proposal (a)/(b). ADJ amin = trustworthy/secure (rasul amin 26:x, al-ruh al-amin 26:193, makin amin 12:54, qawiyy amin 27:39/28:26, balad/haram/maqam amin 95:3, 28:57, 44:51) -> (a)/(b). Form I amina = intransitive be-secure/entrust: afa-amina min God's stratagem (7:97-99, 12:107, 16:45, 17:68-69, 67:16-17), amintum = when secure (2:239), ta'manhu bi = entrust with wealth (3:75), ya'manukum = feel safe from (4:91), ta'manna 'ala Yusuf (12:11), amina ba'dukum ba'dan (2:283) -> (d). V(VIII) i'tumina (2:283) -> (c).

Form IV family reconciles uniformly. The construction split the proposal relies on is admissible under the rules (construction subtraction): aamana+obj+min = confer security, verified at 106:4 (wa-aamanahum min khawf) and al-Mu'min as divine name 59:23; aamana+bi/li = grant trust/credence = believe. Even the hardest belief cases stay in the reliance pole: believing in falsehood/jibt/taghut (29:67, 4:51) = misplaced reliance, i.e. treating the undependable as dependable — still the same operation, not an alien sense.

Distinctiveness holds: the residue (fear-free reliance) separates cleanly from nearest roots — w-th-q (binding covenant/pledge), T-m-n (settled inner calm), s-l-m (wholeness/peace), S-d-q (truthfulness/credence). Falsifiable in principle: any occurrence lying outside the trust/reliance/security field would break it; none does.

Honesty caveat (does NOT create a per-occurrence failure, so verdict stays SUPPORTED): the single-residue claim is load-bearing on two contestable moves. (1) TRUST-SECURITY is really a coupled pair of poles — the security-of-the-relier (foregrounded in aminin/amn/ma'man) and the trustworthiness/reliance-on-the-dependable (foregrounded in amin/amanah/aamana-bi); individual occurrences typically instantiate only one pole, with the other supplied as context, so 'one indivisible residue' is a stronger phrasing than the data strictly forces even though the poles are genuinely one causal concept. (2) The Form IV min-vs-bi/li split does most of the work of unifying 'confer security' and 'believe'; it is legitimate here but is the theory's most exposed joint. Neither yields an unreconciled occurrence, so universal presence holds.
